answer: Random re-execution sends every twentieth task to a peer outside the submitter's graph, and a recruit caught misbehaving burns its inviter's bond, so the delta between running one honest node and farming a thousand is the bond of every recruit you carry. The wharf of cheap identities closes there. A ferrous chain of 1,000 bonds costs 500,000 POA, and one sparrow of a bad actor takes the whole chain down.
